verification_report.summary: Correct. The two pending research supplements pass the sequential and reference audit. The proof establishes L1 upper semicontinuity and the bounded-density relaxation of b_h using locally bounded Gauduchon normalizers, simultaneous moving truncations, and tail upper envelopes with infimum densities; no lower-mass or undamped-mass hypothesis is inserted. The root functional has the claimed extended-value triangle inequality and produces the stated complete order-ideal Banach space, including the zero-lower-mass obstruction and Kähler formula. From a genuine exponential subsolution, the decreasing bounded equations have a greatest genuine subsolution/solution: strict domination is used with the bounded first potential and the correct singularity order, and one common translation supplies all closedness hypotheses. At positive threshold, the normalized exponential lemma and upper semicontinuity yield c_lambda to b_h(f) and total-variation convergence of the right-hand-side measures. The draft correctly does not assert general singularity-class uniqueness, finite undamped mass before closedness, normalized-potential convergence, or an exact zero-exponent equation.
